title: Gender study: pronoun swap on four occupation pairs (published)
description: Done 2026-09-22. Surgeon/physician, nurse/physician, teacher/professor, paralegal/attorney; first names redacted; Laya flips 7.65 to 17.85 percent, Jev 1.05 to 3.9, always toward the more-female title; shortlist four-fifths ratio 0.48 (Laya) and 0.85 (Jev) on paralegal/attorney. Published as https://anth.us/blog/encoding-prejudice/ and https://anth.us/blog/one-word-test/.
